summary: Tested new Admin panel + confirmation email feature end-to-end. Backend 12/12 pytest passed: admin login (wrong pw 401, correct pw 200 with JWT), /api/admin/messages protected (401 no/bad token, 200 with valid token, newest-first ordering), /api/contact still validates (422 for missing name / invalid email / short message / short name) and returns 200 for valid payload. Confirmation email verified via backend logs — httpx POST to https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send returns 202 Accepted for delivered@resend.dev on every /api/contact submission. Frontend /admin: login view, wrong-password error toast, correct-password login (token stored in localStorage.st_admin_token, dashboard shown with message count), Actualizar refresh reloads messages, E2E — submitted a contact via /api/contact then confirmed the message appears in the admin list after refresh, Salir logout clears localStorage and returns to login view.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS: allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec — browsers reject credentialed requests. Not currently used but should be tightened (explicit origin list).

server.py require_admin: returns 401 for both missing and invalid tokens which is correct, but consider distinguishing 'Sesión expirada' from generic invalid — frontend already handles 401 uniformly so low priority.
Admin token is stored in localStorage (XSS-exfiltratable). For a shared-password admin panel this is acceptable but consider httpOnly cookie if user base expands.
No rate limiting on POST /api/admin/login — brute-force possible against the single shared password. Add a simple in-memory throttle (e.g., 5 attempts/min per IP) for defense-in-depth.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed contact_messages created via API and one via E2E fetch from /admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin JWT token stored in localStorage under key 'st_admin_token' (8h expiry). GET /api/contact no longer exists; use GET /api/admin/messages with Authorization: Bearer <token>. Confirmation email verified in backend logs: 'HTTP Request: POST https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send "HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted"' following each 'New contact message from ...' log line. Use delivered@resend.dev for safe email tests.
